Jim how do you reflect on that 90 minutes um I thought first half we were 
really really good um you started the game in a positive manner put Rangers 
under a lot of pressure and um you know possibly could have been a couple of 
goals in front before Rangers managed to get the equalizer um you know I thought 
the second half it was the polar opposite to everything that we've done 
in the first half now don't get me wrong the timings of the of the goals we've 
got a big impact as well you know Rangers scoring so soon after halftime I 
think uh you know ended the confidence a little bit but it's the manner in which 
we concede that goal that is the most frustrating part for me because we 
defended the box brilliantly in the first half the shape of the team was 
excellent out of possession but you know we have to recognize in that certain 
moment where the danger is and where the threat is and um you know we've got a 1v1 
situation our Defender just needs to check a shoulder a little bit and see 
where proper is and make sure that we're in that position to stop that ball going 
inside um you know the Rangers Center half is looking to fire a ball across 
the six-yard Box Uh Kevin Holt is really unfortunate by trying to block it ends 
up turning it into our own net um but you know at 2-1 you know was so much 
time left on the clock we still felt we would get chances but the the simple 
fact of the matter is when the ball went forward in the second half we didn't 
retain possession enough and Rangers won a lot of those four uh first contacts uh 
I have to say in defense to the forward players you know sometimes the service 
up to them wasn't particularly great but the game just became too stretched in 
the second half our Midfield couldn't get up on top of the second balls and it 
just became a bit frantic and we've lost our shape and uh that is the real 
disappointment it was maybe similar in Monday in the sense that even in that 
second half we still had a few chances to go and equalize and over the piece I 
think we had the post three times yeah we've hit the woodwork three times albeit  
I think one of those was was offside um you know the third goal you know 
comes from um us trying to commit bodies forward um you know we don't do well 
enough with a diagonal ball um and we leave ourselves open at the back and you 
know look it's a brilliant finish from from ders um you know just to to wrap 
the game up for Rangers but I get back to the point you know what we' done in 
the first half in terms of the intensity in terms of our ball retention it was 
really really good in the second half we turned over possession far too often and 
it was uh it became a real challenge for the midfielders to you know try and get 
up and and and win those second balls and win those little battles in the 
central Midfield area and um you know that enabled then Rangers to get a real 
foothold in the second 45 so yes it's a major disappointment even more so 
because it was a game that we felt we could actually win and we you know set 
up to try and win it and um you know of course goals change games you know we 
had moments in the game that we could have definitely scored more goals but 
you know that second half we can't allow the shape of the team to to um dismantle 
um in the in the way that it did what do you put that down to well I think it's 
the timing of the second goal I think you know just after halftime I think it 
really does uh take a bit of wind out of the sails but um you know I I don't want 
to repeat myself but you know I just don't think we've done well enough on 
the ball I don't think we we held on to the ball long enough um we weren't able 
to get any real good passages of play in that second half we went a little bit 
too long too often uh as opposed to in the first half we actually played some 
you know half decent football and um we know that allowed Us in the first 45 to 
get the ball out wide to Glenn and to Will and Ryan strain and Kai and every 
time we put balls in the Box in the second half uh sorry in the first half 
we put the Rangers backline under real pressure and um we weren't able to do 
that in the second half because we weren't able to get up the pitch enough 
how important obviously traveling to Kar next week how important do you feel is 
to put an end to run a back Tob back defeats now and and get something from 
the game yeah I mean um you know we we've always showed a good positive 
reaction to to defeats and um you know we were expecting a similar response 
against karuk a different type of game um you know obviously on a difficult 
surface as we know but um you know we've performed well against Kilmarnock in the 
in in the couple of fixtures that we've had um apart from that 15 minute spell 
that we had down at Rugby Park at the start of the second half but um yeah 
it's going to be a difficult challenge you know they're all tough tests you 
know I suppose the one positive that we can take from the weekend is that the 
league table hasn't changed a great deal um you know the teams around us drop 
points okay Hibs maybe gained one on us but um the other teams lost and I 
suppose that is the disappointment we had an opportunity today to take 
advantage of those results yesterday and we weren't able to do that
title: Jim Goodwin Post Match Interview | Dundee United 1-3 Rangers
